title: Change the QR code size, colour or position on a display
summary: Override the default QR Control settings for 1 display so its QR code fits the screen and the content around it.
bodyMd:
Each display can override the platform's default QR code settings. Use this when a display's content leaves no room for the default size, or when the default colour does not contrast with the creative.

Before you begin

  • An HQ Admin account.
  • QR Control enabled at platform level — see Enable QR Control and set the default QR code settings.

Steps

  1. In the left navigation, select Displays & Devices.
  2. Select the display's name.
  3. Select the Enabled Features tab.
  4. Tick Enable QR Control. Its settings appear under it.
  5. In Size, enter the QR code's width in pixels, for example 100.
  6. Select the Qr Code Colour swatch and choose a colour that contrasts with the campaign creative.
  7. Select the Connected Icon/Logo Colour swatch and choose the colour of the icon shown once a phone is connected to the display.
  8. In QR Control - Mobile Site Template, choose the template that opens when a visitor scans this display's QR code.
  9. Select Save Changes.

Verify it worked

Within a minute the display redraws its QR code at the new size and colour. Scan it: the mobile site template you chose opens, and the QR code on the display changes to the connected icon in the colour you set.
